{{Quote|Mm. I once had a pet named Lucky that reminded me of home. And then it died. And then I ate it. And it was supremely delicious.|Neeku Vozo, to Kazuda Xiono|audio=PetLucky-TheTripleDark.flac|<ref name="Triple Dark" />}}
'''Lucky''' was a beloved pet of the [[Kadas'sa'Nikto]]<ref name="Checking Out Kaz's Trophy" /> [[Technician|mechanic]]<ref name="Ultimate SW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> [[Neeku Vozo]]. Lucky [[Death|died]] at some point, after which Vozo [[Diet|ate]] the pet and found<ref name="Triple Dark" /> him<ref name="Checking Out Kaz's Trophy" /> delicious.<ref name="Triple Dark" /> In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> when Vozo was impressed by [[Resistance]] [[spy]] [[Kazuda Xiono]]'s numerous possessions,<ref name="Triple Dark" /> he<ref name="Checking Out Kaz's Trophy" /> asked what a [[Color|golden]] [[starship]]–shaped object was, so Xiono informed Vozo that it was his [[Kaz's lucky trophy|lucky trophy]] that reminded him of his home,<ref name="Triple Dark" /> the [[planet]]<ref name="Hosnian Prime">{{Databank|hosnian-prime|Hosnian Prime}}</ref> [[Hosnian Prime]].<ref name="Ultimate SW" /> Vozo responded that he had once had a pet named Lucky who reminded the Nikto of his own home,<ref name="Triple Dark" /> the planet<ref name="Nikto (Red)">{{Databank|nikto-red|Nikto (Red)}}</ref> [[Kintan]],<ref name="Ultimate SW" /> and mentioned the pet's death and subsequent consumption, but Xiono interrupted the [[Nikto]] before he could describe what happened after eating Lucky.<ref name="Triple Dark" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lucky was first mentioned in "[[The Triple Dark]],"<ref name="Triple Dark" /> the third episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|first season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'', which aired on [[October 14]], [[2018]].<ref name="Disney Press">{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}}</ref> The scene featuring Lucky's mention was previewed earlier in the year on [[August 29]] in a featurette to introduce [[Team Fireball|Team ''Fireball'']], which was posted on the official ''Star Wars'' [[Wikipedia:YouTube|YouTube]] channel.<ref name="Meet Team Fireball">{{SWYouTube|dlucTaqVVcs|Meet Team Fireball | Star Wars Resistance|sw_url=video/meet-team-fireball-star-wars-resistance}}</ref> In [[Vanessa Rubio-Barreau]]'s [[2019]] French junior novel ''[[Star Wars Resistance: Triples Ténèbres]]'', he was referred to as "Tiboulon" instead.<ref name="The Triple Dark French">''[[Star Wars Resistance: Triples Ténèbres]]''</ref>
